holderQuote: Lyfelt was a career politician, someone who’d gained a [Politician] class
Prost grinned. She might be a [Politician], but she wasn’t used to someone like Helm, who was used to saying what needed saying over the roar of a forge.
Krshia, [Royal Shopkeeper], and [Politician] by way of her new status as Councilmember of Liscor, stared at the white Gnoll.

“Some aren’t pleased. But they understand my position. I had a number of very lengthy talks. Productive ones! Raelt, Raelt, I am a [Politician]. Events like this only serve to help me, and thus Belchan.”
The [King] liked his friend, the [Prime Minister], but sometimes he thought too much like a [Politician].
Lyfelt’s mouth worked silently. For once, the [Politician] had no quick reply. For a moment.

It had shown them just how overwhelming their foe was. So the King of Destruction had shattered their morale. In his city, Prime Minister Lyfelt might be in power, but when the King of Destruction rode on the city, his head might be offered at the gates for some modicum of mercy.
Mireden Raithland was vying for his seat with the savvy of an experienced [Politician]
